title: Rosemary Beach 3BR Vacation Rental with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Stay at Highland Cottage, a 3BR, 3.5BA Rosemary Beach vacation rental with private beach access, steps from the Sky Pool, and tennis courts. Sleeps 10.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love- 4K LG OLED HDTV, Sonos Sound System, Apple TV, Cable, Harmony Elite Remote- Smart Home Features controllable with our guest mobile app- Make it a 4 Bedroom and accommodate 4 more by adding the Highland Carriage House - 4 Free Beach Cruiser Bikes- 1 Minute walk to the Sky Pool (covered heated community pool)With a courtyard reminiscent of a sultry New Orleans afternoon, the Highland Cottage in Rosemary Beach will capture your imagination and your heart completely. Just picture yourself sitting at one of the two teakwood tables, with a mint julep in hand, enjoying the quiet hum of conversation and the company of your closest friends and family.Built to be the personal beach home of the architect, no detail has been overlooked in this elegant and charming vacation home. The reverse floor plan maximizes the lovely views and afternoon breezes from the floor-to-ceiling windows on the upper floor as the bedrooms downstairs stay cozy and cool at night.Enter the first floor through the courtyard to be greeted by three luxurious bedrooms, each accompanied by an ensuite bath. The Master suite with a king bed offers all the privacy of its own wing. From its high beamed ceilings to the dual wing chairs for a quiet moment alone, you’ll feel pampered and relaxed. The additional two suites offer a King bed and the other two twins and two double/full beds in a bunk bed style, each with its own private bath.As you ascend the stairs to the upper level, you’ll be greeted by dramatic high ceilings and a fashionable living room with a large sectional sofa and HDTV. The formal dining space offers a round dining table situated in front of French doors with the sunshine streaming in. And the classic kitchen boasts plenty of space to create your most delicious culinary specialties.Need a little more space? Check out the Highland Carriage House, located above the garage in the courtyard. Rents separately.Perfectly located just steps from the Racquet Club, Tennis Courts and Sky Pool, the Highland Cottage will become your most favorite Rosemary Beach vacation spot. Book it today.GROUND LEVEL EXTERIORLarge courtyard with outdoor dining table, comfortable seating throughout, string lighting for the perfect ambianceTwo outdoor showers (one private and one open air)GROUND LEVEL INTERIORGUEST BEDROOM: King bed with ensuite bathGUEST BEDROOM: Two Custom Bunk Beds (Two twins and two double/full beds) with ensuite bathMASTER BEDROOM: King bed with dual nightstands with lamps, seating area for two, ceiling fan, HDTV and built-in dresserMASTER BATH: Dual vanities and an oversized walk-in shower with two shower headsSECOND LEVEL INTERIORLiving room with sectional sofa, leather side chair, HDTV, sofa table, coffee table and cocktail tablesDining room with round table and seating for 7 and decorative side piecesKitchen with double refrigerator, gas stove, built-in microwave, center island with seating for twoSECOND LEVEL EXTERIORTeak dining table for four overlooking neighborhood green space**For additional guests, see our listing for The Highland Carriage House.TDT-018364
